fullPassage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly — what I thought was a ridiculous pace. Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life. And, being the rookie, I wanted to prove myself to the group. Why not show off my superior conditioning? So up front I went. Then, as we approached 16,000 feet, I suddenly began to feel dizzy. Not long after, I was staggering. The group had to take my pack. In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing assistance just to walk. On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.

questions.passage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 경험 많은(experienced) 그룹, 터무니없는(ridiculous) 속도, 우월한(superior) 체력
det.analysis:
✅①experienced — ridiculous — superior: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌②inferior(열등한): superior의 반의어
❌③reasonable(합리적인): ridiculous의 반의어
❌④novice(초보): experienced의 반의어

In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing (B) just to walk. On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a (C) to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.

det.korean: 비틀거리며(staggering), 도움(assistance)이 필요했고, 짐(burden)이 되었습니다.

✅①staggering — assistance — burden: 원문과 정확히 일치
❌②advantage(이점): burden의 반의어
❌③resistance(저항): assistance의 반의어
❌④steady(안정된): staggering의 반의어

questions.passage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ steadily(안정적으로) → staggering(비틀거리며): 어지러움 후 비틀거린 것이지 안정적으로 걸은 것이 아닙니다.
det.analysis:
❌④steadily(안정적으로) → staggering(비틀거리며): 어지러움 후 비틀거림
✅①experienced: 원문 일치
✅②ridiculous: 원문 일치
✅③superior: 원문 일치

questions.passage: After a few nights, we <u>① ventured</u> out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were <u>② climbing</u> so slowly. And, being the <u>③ rookie</u>, I wanted to <u>④ prove</u> myself to the group. Now all I felt was <u>⑤ relief</u> for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ⑤ relief(안도) → guilt(죄책감): 짐이 된 것에 대해 안도가 아니라 죄책감을 느꼈습니다.
det.analysis:
❌⑤relief(안도) → guilt(죄책감): 짐이 되어 미안한 감정
✅①ventured: 원문 일치
✅②climbing: 원문 일치
✅③rookie: 원문 일치
✅④prove: 원문 일치

questions.passage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly — what I thought was a <u>ridiculous</u> pace. Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ridiculous와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: ridiculous = absurd = 터무니없는, 말도 안 되는
det.analysis:
✅absurd(터무니없는): ridiculous의 정확한 동의어
❌reasonable(합리적인): 반의어
❌moderate(적당한): 반대 뉘앙스
❌sensible(분별 있는): 반의어

questions.passage: Then, as we approached 16,000 feet, I suddenly began to feel dizzy. Not long after, I was <u>staggering</u>. The group had to take my pack. In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing assistance just to walk.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 staggering과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: staggering = tottering = 비틀거리는, 휘청거리는
det.analysis:
✅tottering(비틀거리는): staggering의 동의어
❌marching(행진하는): 안정적인 걸음
❌striding(성큼 걷는): 자신감 있는 걸음
❌sprinting(전력 질주하는): 빠른 달리기

questions.passage: On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a <u>burden</u> to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 burden과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: burden = load = 짐, 부담. 그룹에 짐이 된 것에 대한 죄책감을 느꼈습니다.
det.analysis:
✅load(짐): burden의 정확한 동의어
❌advantage(이점): 반대 개념
❌asset(자산): 반대 개념
❌benefit(이익): 반대 개념

questions.passage: Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life. And, being the rookie, I wanted to prove myself to the group. Why not show off my <u>superior</u> conditioning? So up front I went.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 superior와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: superior(우월한) ↔ inferior(열등한). 자신의 체력이 우월하다고 생각했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅inferior(열등한): superior의 정확한 반의어
❌better(더 나은): superior의 유의어
❌greater(더 큰): superior의 유의어
❌higher(더 높은): superior의 유의어

questions.passage: On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was <u>guilt</u> for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 guilt와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: guilt(죄책감) ↔ pride(자부심). 짐이 된 것에 대해 죄책감을 느꼈습니다.
det.analysis:
✅pride(자부심): guilt의 반의어 — 죄책감의 반대는 자긍심
❌remorse(후회): guilt의 유의어
❌shame(수치심): guilt의 유의어
❌sorrow(슬픔): guilt의 유의어

questions.passage: On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a __________ to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그룹에 짐(burden)이 된 것에 대한 죄책감을 느꼈습니다.
det.analysis:
✅④burden: guilt + 도움 필요 = 짐이 됨
❌①leader: 리더가 아님
❌②hero: 영웅이 아님
❌③mentor: 신참이므로 멘토 불가
det.tip: burden = 짐, 부담 — 도움이 필요한 상태가 된 것

questions.passage: In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing __________ just to walk. On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 걸으려면 도움(assistance)이 필요한 상태가 되었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅③assistance: needing assistance just to walk = 걷기 위해 도움이 필요
❌①approval: 승인은 맥락과 무관
❌②permission: 허가는 맥락과 무관
❌④instruction: 지시는 맥락과 무관

questions.passage: Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life. And, being the __________, I wanted to prove myself to the group. Why not show off my superior conditioning?
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 신참(rookie)이기에 자신을 증명하고 싶었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅③rookie: 신참이라서 자신을 증명하고 싶은 동기
❌①expert: 경험자라면 증명할 필요 없음
❌②leader: 리더라면 이미 인정받음
❌④veteran: 베테랑이라면 증명할 필요 없음
det.tip: rookie = 신참, 초보자 — 자신을 증명하고 싶은 이유

questions.passage: The group had to take my pack. In a <u>matter</u> of minutes, I became a basket case, needing assistance just to walk.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 matter가 글에서 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: in a matter of minutes = 불과 몇 분 만에. matter는 여기서 '양, 기간'의 뜻입니다.
det.analysis:
✅기간(양): in a matter of ~ = 불과 ~만에
❌문제: What's the matter?에서의 뜻
❌물질: 과학 용어로서의 뜻
❌중요하다: 동사로서의 뜻
det.tip: in a matter of minutes = 불과 몇 분 만에 (양/기간의 의미)

questions.passage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly — what I thought was a ridiculous <u>pace</u>. Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 pace가 글에서 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: pace는 여기서 '속도'를 뜻합니다. 등반 속도가 터무니없이 느리다고 생각했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅속도: a ridiculous pace = 터무니없는 속도
❌걸음: pace의 다른 뜻이나 여기선 speed의 의미
❌보폭: 물리적 보폭이 아닌 전체 속도
❌서성거림: pacing의 뜻으로 다른 맥락
det.tip: pace = speed = rate (속도) — 이 문맥에서의 의미

questions.passage: The group members were all __________ (experience), so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly.
questions.stem: 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 어형을 변환하여 빈칸에 쓰시오.

det.korean: experience(명사/동사) → experienced(형용사): 경험이 많은. were all + 형용사 구조입니다.
det.analysis: experience → experienced: 명사/동사 → 형용사 변환. were all experienced = 모두 경험이 많았다.

questions.passage: On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and __________ (dizzy).
questions.stem: 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 어형을 변환하여 빈칸에 쓰시오.

det.korean: dizzy(형용사) → dizziness(명사): nausea, headache와 and로 병렬 연결되므로 명사형이 필요합니다.
det.analysis: dizzy → dizziness: 형용사 → 명사 변환. nausea, headache, and dizziness (명사 병렬)

questions.passage: On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was __________ for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 짐이 된 것에 대한 죄책감(guilt)을 느꼈습니다.
det.analysis:
✅④guilt: 짐이 됨 + pushed too hard = 죄책감
❌①excitement: 흥분은 맥락과 반대
❌②satisfaction: 만족은 맥락과 반대
❌③confidence: 자신감은 이미 무너진 상태
det.tip: guilt = 죄책감 — 자신의 행동에 대한 후회와 책임감

questions.passage: Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't __________ myself so hard.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 자신을 너무 밀어붙이지(pushed) 않았으면 좋았을 텐데 하고 후회했습니다.
det.analysis:
✅④pushed: wished + had not pushed(과거완료) = 후회의 가정법
❌①respected: 존경과 무관
❌②excluded: 배제와 무관
❌③celebrated: 축하와 무관
